description: [WRITE] Insert or replace an item in a table. Supports conditional writes via condition_expression. Empty strings, empty sets, and invalid numbers are rejected. Sets are deduplicated. Unused ExpressionAttributeNames/Values are rejected.

condition_expression.description: Condition expression that must be satisfied for the put to succeed

expression_attribute_names.description: Substitution tokens for expression attribute names, e.g. {"#n": "name"}

expression_attribute_values.description: Substitution tokens for expression attribute values, in DynamoDB JSON format

item.description: Item to put, in DynamoDB JSON format. Example: {"pk": {"S": "user#1"}, "name": {"S": "Alice"}}

return_consumed_capacity.description: What consumed capacity to return: TOTAL for the operation's total, INDEXES for the total broken down by table and index, or NONE (the default) for none. Figures follow DynamoDB's charging rules and match what the DynamoDB API returns for the same request.

return_values.description: What to return: NONE or ALL_OLD

return_values_on_condition_check_failure.description: What to return on ConditionalCheckFailedException: ALL_OLD or NONE

name: put_item
